artworks.title: The Egyptians Pursue the Israelites
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large group of soldiers on horseback and on foot pursuing a fleeing multitude along a path between towering walls of water. The composition is densely populated with figures, armor, and weapons. The horses' stances and the soldiers' attire suggest a historical or mythological context. The intricate line work demonstrates skill and precision, typical of engravings or classical etchings. The scene conveys a feeling of urgency and tension, with the turbulent sea and the determined expression of the soldiers accentuating the narrative's drama.

artworks.title: Pharaoh's Army Drowns in the Red Sea
artworks.description: The image depicts a large crowd crossing a parted sea. Numerous figures are shown amidst the scene, some with arms raised towards the sky. Others are leading animals like camels, horses, and sheep. The sea is depicted with frothy waves on one side, creating walls of water for safe passage on a dry path. In the background, more individuals are visible. The drawing captures a moment of divine intervention and human relief, focusing on gestures and interactions among figures.

artworks.title: The Defeat of the Amalikits by the Hebrews
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene with horses and warriors in action. The scene is dynamic as warriors on horseback engage in combat. The central figure is surrounded by swirling bodies and rearing horses. Lances and spears are thrust into the fray, with fallen warriors adding to the sense of struggle. The drawing uses intricate linework to create texture and depth, combining shading techniques to enhance the intensity of the battle. In the background, a hillside with rows of shields and lances sets the stage as a battlefield. The style resembles detailed, dramatic compositions from the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: The Taking of the City of Jericho
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical battle scene. The drawing depicts armored warriors engaged in combat, some on horseback and others on foot. Several soldiers carry shields and spears. The background features city walls, with numerous figures in the distance and a densely packed line of troops. The style is reminiscent of a detailed engraving, where lines create depth and detail. Classic architectural structures and formations are faintly visible.

artworks.title: Joshua Ordering the Sun to Stop
artworks.description: This is an image of a battle scene with horses and soldiers. The drawing captures a chaotic and dramatic battle with intense movement. A rearing horse in the foreground is surrounded by fallen soldiers. Armed figures on horseback and on foot are engaged in combat to the left and right. The background shows a vast array of soldiers and horses, adding to the tumultuous atmosphere. The sky above has dynamic light rays cutting through a turbulent sky. The intricate lines and shading create depth and texture in the composition, reflecting the complexity of battle.

artworks.title: Joshua has the Chariots Burned and Cuts the Legs off His Enemies
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene involving horses and warriors. The drawing shows a chaotic battlefield with mounted soldiers in armor. Two rearing horses each have a warrior rider. Fallen soldiers, horses, and weapons are scattered around. Smoke in the sky hints at burning structures or objects. A distant army is seen advancing. The detailed line work and cross-hatching create a dynamic depiction of warfare.

artworks.title: Gideon Chooses His Soldiers
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with soldiers at a riverbank. The soldiers, some on horseback and others on foot, wear armor and helmets. In the foreground, a figure on horseback gestures towards the river where other soldiers are drinking water. To the left, a larger group heads towards the river, some with camels and spears. The background shows mountainous terrain under a cloudy sky. The composition centers around the figure directing attention towards the action at the water.

artworks.title: Gideon Frightens His Enemies in Their Camp
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chaotic scene in a camp with horses and tents. The image shows a densely packed composition depicting a chaotic scene in a camp. Tents are scattered throughout the landscape, and in the foreground, a horse stands prominently. Surrounding the horse, there are figures in various states of movement and action. Flames and smoke can be seen in the background with figures carrying weapons. The texture of the drawing is detailed, emphasizing the folds of clothing, the structure of the tents, and the expressions of turmoil among the figures. The scene is accented with dramatic contrasts of light and shadow.

artworks.title: The Death of Abimelech
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical battle scene capturing soldiers engaged in combat in front of fortifications. Horses are also depicted in the midst of the chaos. The drawing is detailed with fine lines showing the forms and movements of figures and architecture. In the background, there is a sky and distant landscapes. The style shows influences from Renaissance engravings.

artworks.title: David Kills Goliath
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene with warriors on foot and horseback. The central focus is a fallen figure in armor lying on the ground surrounded by soldiers, while others appear to be advancing or in the midst of celebration and display of victory with raised spears and shields. In the foreground, soldiers in various armors, as well as horses, are depicted. The lines and shading suggest depth and action, capturing the chaotic moments of battle with a background filled with soldiers, banners, and tents, indicating a large-scale military camp behind the front lines.

artworks.title: The Triumph of David over Goliath
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a triumphal scene. A large gathering of soldiers and onlookers is depicted. The drawing includes a central figure mounted on a horse and holding a curved object, surrounded by others holding weapons like spears. The scene conveys an atmosphere of victory or celebration through the interactions and gestures of the figures. In the forefront, a parade of figures is shown, some holding musical instruments such as tambourines. The image captures a bustling scene with a successful military campaign being celebrated with crowds and musicians. Banners are raised as figures move through a multitude of people lining the procession path. The detailed line work and shading provide depth and complexity, offering a glimpse into what seems to be an ancient or historical setting. The text at the bottom reads "DAVID E GOLIA TRIUMPHAT," suggesting a biblical theme.

artworks.title: Saul Kills Himself after the Defeat of his Army by the Philistines
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene with armored soldiers on horseback engaged in combat. The scene is filled with movement and intensity, depicted through detailed line work emphasizing the clash of weapons, swirling drapery, and charging horses. Shields and spears accentuate the ferocity of the confrontation, while the background reveals additional soldiers, adding depth to the conflict. The overall impression is one of power, movement, and complexity, capturing the essence of a historical battle in dramatic detail.

artworks.title: Jacob Kills Absalom, Son of King David
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene. Warriors and horses are depicted in a chaotic combat environment. In the foreground, a figure on horseback is shown in action, along with other figures engaging in martial activities. The scene is detailed and dynamic, with overlapping figures creating depth. The use of line work and shading adds intensity to the composition. Trees and foliage in the background contrast with the action in the foreground. The drawing captures a moment of high tension and movement.

artworks.title: Elisha Bringing the Blinded Syrian Army to the King of Israel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ancient battle scene with soldiers and a city backdrop. The image depicts an organized procession of soldiers and horses, carrying spears and banners, moving towards a walled city. In the foreground, some soldiers are seen pointing and observing the scene, wearing armor and helmets with distinct plumes. The background is filled with architectural structures typical of an ancient city, featuring towers and a gate that suggest a fortified settlement. The scene is highly detailed, with fine lines capturing the mood and action of the era depicted. Latin text inscriptions are included at the bottom.

artworks.title: The Exterminating Angel Vanquishing the Army of Sennacherib
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chaotic battle scene. The image depicts a dramatic battlefield filled with chaos and motion. Numerous soldiers and horses are in a state of frenzy amidst what appears to be a sudden attack or disaster. In the foreground, there are several figures either fallen or in various poses of distress, with a central focus on a large fallen warrior lying on the ground. Behind them are tents, while in the background, more soldiers and riders can be seen advancing. A figure with wings seems to be descending from the sky above the scene. The landscape features a fortified city in the distance. The illustration is intricately detailed with dynamic lines emphasizing movement and turmoil.

artworks.title: Josaphat Thanking God for His Victory
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with numerous figures and tents. The image depicts figures engaged in various activities across a landscape. In the foreground, two individuals are collecting or examining objects scattered on the ground, which include various vessels and possibly armor. Behind them, a group of helmeted and armored figures stand, some blowing trumpets and others holding flags. To the left, figures appear to be organizing or preparing to move. Further back, tents and figures and animals, including elephants, stretch into the distance, suggesting a large camp or gathering. The background displays a rolling landscape with mountains under a sky. The style of the lines and the detailing suggest a classical or Renaissance influence.

artworks.title: Judith and Holofernes
artworks.description: The image shows a camp scene with detailed elements. An elaborately dressed figure is emerging from a tent, while another figure is partially obscured inside the tent, reaching towards something on the ground. The tent has intricate textile patterns and there are other elements like furniture inside. Outside, there are various tents in a campsite. A large fire burns in the background, casting shadows. Horses are grazing nearby, along with individuals resting or being active.

artworks.title: The Israelites Rebuilding the Walls of Jerusalem
artworks.description: This depicts a medieval city scene under construction. Workers are building what appear to be fortifications or city walls. The scene shows workers engaged in construction activities, including working with tools, sculpting stones, and hewing timber. Arches frame workers in the left, while an ox-drawn carriage is seen on the right. In the background, elephants are leading a procession towards the city gate. The architectural structures include crenellations and arches typical of medieval style.

artworks.title: Rainy Landscape
artworks.artist: Lucas Emil Vosterman, after Lodewijk de Vadder
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with an elevated viewpoint, displaying the terrain extending into the distance. The horizon is high in the composition with a village consisting of small buildings and trees. The sky has fine lines indicating movement, potentially rain, blending into detailed, swirling clouds. In the foreground, there is a dirt path surrounded by rocks and tall grass. The background displays hills with trees, leading to the horizon. The scene is depicted in a monochromatic palette of browns and grays.

artworks.title: Rainy Landscape
artworks.artist: Lucas Emil Vosterman, after Lodewijk de Vadder
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from an elevated position looking across a countryside scene. The horizon, about one-third from the top of the image, is defined by a line of trees and a distant settlement that includes a church-like structure with a spire. Fine, diagonal lines across the sky suggest rain, with a contrast between the cloudy sky and the rain-covered area. The technique uses delicate hatching and cross-hatching brushstrokes throughout, creating texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of sepia or dark brown ink on a lighter background. Closest to us, a rugged, rocky terrain with a path is bordered by trees on the right. In the distance, there are rolling terrain and wooded areas.

artworks.title: Count Nicolas Zrinyi
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a bearded man shown from the waist up. He is positioned with his upper body turned slightly to the side, gazing directly at the viewer. His facial features are prominent with a full beard and a serious expression, and he wears a distinctive hat adorned with a large feather plume. The man's clothing is richly detailed, featuring a patterned coat with a high collar and buttons. He is holding a set of keys in his left hand, which rests on a surface. Surrounding the figure, there is an ornate frame that integrates elaborate illustrations, including musical instruments, helmets, and various objects. In the background, a detailed landscape is visible, depicting scattered buildings and trees, under a sky with a winged figure holding a cross in the clouds. The overall artwork is intricately designed with an emphasis on engraved patterns and historical details.

artworks.title: Title Page for "De droeve Ellendigheden van den Oorloogh"
artworks.artist: Gerrit van Schagen after Jacques Callot
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative text page surrounded by figures in historical attire and military elements. The main section of the image is occupied by text in a classical serif font introducing the title. Surrounding the text are intricate illustrations; to the left are figures wearing ornate, period-specific clothing, possibly soldiers given their armor and weapons like halberds and swords. The right side mirrors this design, with more similarly attired figures. Below the text, a variety of military paraphernalia like drums, trumpets, and cannonballs are artistically arranged along with heraldic elements such as flags and a crown. The drawing is characterized by fine lines and high contrast between the ink and background paper, typical of detailed engraving techniques.

artworks.title: Recruitment of Troops
artworks.artist: Gerrit van Schagen after Jacques Callot
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: A drawing of a military camp scene with soldiers assembled. Soldiers are in orderly rows, holding spears or rifles. In the foreground, individuals in military attire are gathered around a table with coins and items. Tents are visible in the background, along with fortified walls and a tree with sprawling branches.

artworks.title: The Battle
artworks.artist: Gerrit van Schagen after Jacques Callot
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chaotic battle scene. The detailed etching depicts horses and soldiers in various states of action, some charging into battle while others lie fallen on the ground. In the background, dense smoke billows upwards, blending into the lines used to create a cloudy sky. The foreground features fallen soldiers and horses strewn across the battlefield. The fringes of the battle extend to fortified structures on the hills at the edges of the image. The overall intensity is captured through the swirling lines and overlapping figures, creating a vivid portrayal of battle.
